# Basiq Changelog

> Published release history. See the [root index](https://api.basiq.io/llms.txt).

ReadMe serves a generated changelog index instead of this file. Keep these links
in sync with the root index, which provides the full published history.
Entries are listed alphabetically by title. HTML links are used where the published Markdown endpoint fails.
